record.reason: GRAIL performs post-hoc blockwise linear reconstruction to compensate accuracy loss after structured network compression without labeled-data finetuning; the paper evaluates generic vision/network compression settings. It does not test LLMs or decode-time serving, so transfer to the linked weight-compression lineage is plausible but unresolved.
record.title: GRAIL: Post-hoc Compensation by Linear Reconstruction for Compressed Networks
